sign.confinedSpace: Confined space — entry by authorisation only

step.briefing: Read and acknowledge the mission briefing

meet.operator: Check in with the Control Room Operator

instruction.briefing: Read the assignment carefully, then press Acknowledge.

meet.supervisor: Walk to the supervisor (blue marker) and press E to talk.
meet.safety_officer: Walk to the Safety Officer (green helmet) and press E to talk.
meet.senior_tech: Walk to the Senior Technician (orange coverall) and press E to talk.
meet.operator: Walk to the Control Room Operator (headset) and press E to talk.
meet.coordinator: Walk to the Emergency Coordinator (red helmet) and press E to talk.
meet.contractor: Walk to the contractor (blue helmet) and press E to talk.

hint.briefing: The briefing window lists your task. Press Acknowledge when you have read it.

meet.supervisor: Look for the name plate above the supervisor's head, then press E.
meet.safety_officer: The Safety Officer wears a green helmet. Face them and press E.
meet.senior_tech: The Senior Technician wears an orange coverall. Face them and press E.
meet.operator: The operator wears a headset and a blue vest. Face them and press E.
meet.coordinator: The Emergency Coordinator wears a red helmet. Face them and press E.
meet.contractor: The contractor wears a blue helmet. Face them and press E.

story.nothingMore: Nothing more from me right now.

work.flagTitle: Flag this entry if it is missing, incomplete or does not match the job
work.flagHelp: Flag only the entries you believe are missing, incomplete or inconsistent. Flagging correct entries counts as a mistake.
work.inventoryHelp: Select what the task briefing requires. Report any item that looks damaged instead of using it.
work.commsHelp: Choose who to contact and what to report. Your choice is recorded.
work.routeMapLabel: Site plan with the possible routes

docs.notValid: Not valid for real work. Training simulation only.
